    The fundamental groupoid of the opposite ray category #

    Reversing paths and inverting gives mutually inverse functors between the fundamental groupoids of P and Pᵒᵖ (RayCat.opEquiv): an arrow e goes to the inverse of the class of the reversed arrow. Hence Π(P) and Π(Pᵒᵖ) are isomorphic (RayCat.endEquivOp).
